caption: Slippery road
colour: red triangle, black skidding-car symbol on white
explanation: The road ahead may be slippery; ease off the throttle, avoid harsh braking or steering, and keep the bike upright.
mnemonic: Skid marks = slippery.
notes: Commons description: 'Slippery road ahead (TSRGDNO 557)'. Category: SVG warning road signs - slippery surface.

caption: Steep hill downwards
colour: red triangle, black downhill gradient symbol with percentage
explanation: A steep descent is ahead; select a low gear in good time and use engine braking so you are not relying only on the brakes.
mnemonic: Downhill wedge with a % = steep descent ahead.
notes: Commons description: 'Steep hill downwards ahead (10%) (TSRGD Drawing No. P 523.1)'. Number shown varies with the actual gradient.

caption: Steep hill upwards
colour: red triangle, black uphill gradient symbol with percentage
explanation: A steep climb is ahead; change down to a lower gear early to keep power and momentum up the hill.
mnemonic: Uphill wedge with a % = steep climb ahead.
notes: Commons description: 'Steep hill upwards ahead (20%) (TSRGDNO 524.1)'. Number shown varies with the actual gradient.

caption: Children (school or playground)
colour: red triangle, black symbol of two children walking
explanation: Children may be crossing on their way to or from a school or playground; slow down and watch carefully for them stepping out.
mnemonic: Two kids = keep it slow.
notes: Commons description: 'Children going to or from school or playground ahead (TSRGDNO 545)'. Often shown with a 'School' or 'Patrol' plate.

caption: School crossing patrol ahead
colour: white plate, black word ‘Patrol’
explanation: A school crossing patrol (lollipop person) may be ahead; be ready to stop when they step into the road with their sign.
mnemonic: Just the word ‘Patrol’ = school-crossing (lollipop) patrol ahead.
notes: Commons description: 'School crossing patrol ahead (TSRGDNO 547.1)'.

caption: Pedestrians in road ahead
colour: red triangle, black symbol of a single person walking
explanation: Pedestrians may be walking in the road ahead, often where there is no footway; slow down and give them plenty of room.
mnemonic: One walker = people in the road.
notes: Commons file UK traffic sign 544.1: pedestrians in road ahead (single walking figure). Distinct from 544 which shows two figures on a crossing.

caption: Zebra crossing ahead
colour: red triangle, black single walking figure on crossing stripes
explanation: A pedestrian (zebra) crossing is ahead; slow down and be ready to stop for anyone waiting to cross.
mnemonic: One figure on the stripes = crossing ahead.
notes: Commons description: 'Pedestrian crossing ahead' (TSRGDNO 544), the warning used before a zebra crossing. Two figures on a crossing distinguish it from 544.1.

caption: Frail or disabled pedestrians likely to cross
colour: red triangle, black symbol of elderly people with a walking stick
explanation: Frail or disabled people may be crossing slowly ahead; approach gently and give them extra time to cross.
mnemonic: Walking stick = slower walkers.
notes: Commons description: 'Frail or disabled pedestrians likely to cross road ahead (TSRGDNO 544.2)'.

caption: Cycle route ahead
colour: red triangle, black bicycle symbol on white
explanation: Cyclists may be crossing or joining the road ahead on a cycle route; look out for them and give them room.
mnemonic: Bike in a triangle = cyclists about.
notes: Commons description: 'Cycle route ahead warning (TSRGDNO 950)'. Standard red triangle with black bicycle; fast-model shape guesses were unreliable but the file description confirms the sign.

caption: Cattle
colour: red triangle, black cow symbol on white
explanation: Cattle may be in or crossing the road ahead; slow down, be ready to stop, and pass any animals slowly and quietly.
mnemonic: Cow sign = cattle crossing.
notes: Commons description: 'Cattle likely to be in road ahead (TSRGDNO 548)'.

caption: Wild animals
colour: red triangle, black leaping deer symbol on white
explanation: Wild animals such as deer may run into the road ahead; reduce speed and stay alert, especially at dawn and dusk.
mnemonic: Leaping deer = wild animals.
notes: Commons description: 'Wild animals likely to be in road ahead (TSRGDNO 551)'. Depicts a leaping deer.

caption: Accompanied horses or ponies
colour: red triangle, black ridden-horse symbol on white
explanation: Ridden or led horses may be in or crossing the road ahead; slow right down and pass wide and slow to avoid startling them.
mnemonic: Horse and rider = pass wide and slow.
notes: Commons description: 'Accompanied horses or ponies likely to be in or crossing road ahead (TSRGDNO 550.1)'. Distinct from 550 (wild horses).

caption: Risk of ice
colour: red triangle, black ice-crystal/snowflake symbol on white
explanation: The road ahead may be icy or have packed snow; slow down, keep smooth, and allow much greater stopping distance.
mnemonic: Snowflake = slippery ice.
notes: Commons description: 'Risk of ice or packed snow ahead.' (TSRGDNO 554.2).

caption: Side winds
colour: red triangle, black windsock symbol on white
explanation: Strong crosswinds are likely ahead; hold the bike firmly, expect to be pushed sideways, and take care when overtaking or passing gaps.
mnemonic: Windsock = blown sideways.
notes: Commons description: 'Side winds likely ahead.' (TSRGDNO 581). Depicts a windsock.

caption: Hump bridge
colour: red triangle, black humped-bridge profile symbol on white
explanation: A steep humpback bridge is ahead; slow down so you keep control and do not lose grip or visibility over the crest.
mnemonic: Bump shape = hump bridge.
notes: Commons description: 'Hump bridge ahead (TSRGDNO 528)'.

caption: Falling or fallen rocks
colour: red triangle, black rocks falling down a cliff symbol on white
explanation: Rocks may fall onto, or already lie on, the road ahead; stay alert and be ready to slow or steer around debris.
mnemonic: Rocks tumbling = watch the road surface.
notes: Commons description: 'Risk of falling or fallen rocks ahead.' (TSRGDNO 559). A left-facing variant exists.

caption: Tunnel ahead
colour: red triangle, black tunnel-mouth symbol on white
explanation: A tunnel is ahead where light levels change suddenly; remove sunglasses, switch on dipped headlights, and watch for the change in light.
mnemonic: Black arch = tunnel mouth.
notes: Commons description: 'Tunnel ahead (TSRGDNO 529.1)'.

caption: Low-flying aircraft or sudden aircraft noise
colour: red triangle, black aeroplane symbol on white
explanation: Low-flying aircraft or sudden loud aircraft noise may startle you ahead, often near an airfield; stay relaxed on the controls and do not be distracted.
mnemonic: Plane symbol = sudden noise overhead.
notes: Commons description: 'Low flying aircraft or sudden aircraft noise likely ahead (TSRGDNO 558)'. A helicopter variant is 558.1.

caption: Opening or swing bridge ahead
colour: red triangle, black opening-bridge symbol on white
explanation: An opening or swing bridge is ahead that may be raised or turned for boats; be ready to stop and wait if it is open.
mnemonic: Bridge lifting = may have to wait.
notes: Commons description: 'Opening or swing bridge ahead (TSRGDNO 529)'.

caption: Quayside or river bank
colour: red triangle, black car going into water off a quay symbol on white
explanation: There is an unfenced quayside or river bank ahead with a risk of riding into the water; slow down and keep well back from the edge.
mnemonic: Car off the edge = water ahead.
notes: Commons description: 'Quayside or river bank ahead (TSRGDNO 555)'.

caption: Overhead electric cable
colour: red triangle, black overhead-cable symbol with height figure on white
explanation: The road passes under an electrified overhead cable ahead; note the maximum safe height shown and do not exceed it.
mnemonic: Cable with a height = mind the wire.
notes: Commons description: 'Electrified overhead cable ahead (TSRGD drawing P 779)'. Normally shown with a maximum-height plate.

caption: Other danger
colour: red triangle, black exclamation mark on white
explanation: There is a hazard ahead not covered by other signs, usually explained on a plate beneath; slow down and read the plate.
mnemonic: Exclamation mark = something unexpected.
notes: Commons description: 'Other danger ahead (TSRGDNO 562)'. Almost always accompanied by an explanatory plate.

caption: Ford
colour: red triangle, the word ‘Ford’ in black (no symbol)
explanation: A ford lies ahead where a stream crosses the road; slow right down, check the depth gauge, and ride through gently in a low gear as the surface will be wet and slippery.
mnemonic: Triangle just says the word ‘Ford’ = watch for water across the road.
notes: Commons: 'Ford ahead.' (TSRGD 554).

caption: Try your brakes
colour: white rectangular plate with red triangle and the words 'Try your brakes'
explanation: Placed just after a ford or before a steep descent, this reminds you to test your brakes; pump them gently to dry them out and confirm they bite before you need them.
mnemonic: Just crossed water? Try the brakes.
notes: Commons: worded supplementary warning after a ford / before a steep gradient (TSRGD 554.1).

caption: Soft verges
colour: red triangle, black symbol of a vehicle sinking at the road edge
explanation: The verges beside the road ahead are soft and may give way under a wheel; keep to the firm carriageway and avoid pulling onto the edge, especially to pass or stop.
mnemonic: Soft edge = stay on the tarmac.
notes: Commons: 'Soft verges ahead (TSRGDNO 556.1)'. Distinct from existing 556 'Uneven road'.

caption: Hidden dip
colour: white rectangular plate with red triangle and the words 'Hidden dip'
explanation: There is a dip ahead that hides the road and any traffic in it; slow down so you are not surprised by stopped or oncoming vehicles, walkers or animals you cannot yet see.
mnemonic: Hidden dip = something out of sight.
notes: Commons: 'Hidden dip ahead (TSRGDNO 563V9)'. Worded 563-series warning plate.

caption: Road liable to flooding
colour: white rectangular plate, black words ‘Road liable to flooding’
explanation: The road ahead floods easily and standing water may be deep; slow down, assess the depth before entering, and turn back rather than ride through water you cannot judge.
mnemonic: Worded ‘Road liable to flooding’ = water could be deep.
notes: Commons: 'Road liable to flooding ahead (TSRGDNO 563V12)'.

caption: Cattle grid
colour: red triangle, black symbol of a cattle grid across the road
explanation: A cattle grid spans the road ahead; slow down well before it, as the metal bars are slippery and jolting, and cross squarely and steadily to keep the bike stable.
mnemonic: Bars across the road = cattle grid.
notes: Commons: 'Cattle grid ahead.' (TSRGD 552).

caption: Sheep
colour: red triangle, black sheep symbol on white
explanation: Sheep may be in or crossing the road ahead, often on open moorland; slow down, be ready to stop, and pass them slowly and quietly so they do not bolt.
mnemonic: Sheep symbol = flock on the road.
notes: Commons: 'Sheep likely to be in road ahead (TSRGDNO 549)'. Distinct from 548 'Cattle'.

caption: Agricultural vehicles
colour: red triangle, black tractor symbol on white
explanation: Slow-moving tractors or other farm vehicles may be in or pulling onto the road ahead; expect mud, be patient, and only overtake when you can see well past them.
mnemonic: Tractor symbol = slow farm traffic.
notes: Commons: 'Agricultural vehicles likely to be in road ahead (TSRGDNO 553.1)'.

caption: Migratory toad crossing
colour: red triangle, black toad symbol on white
explanation: Large numbers of toads may be crossing the road ahead in the breeding season; slow down so you can avoid them and any volunteers helping them across.
mnemonic: Toad symbol = amphibians on the road.
notes: Commons: 'Migratory toad crossing ahead.' (TSRGD 551.1).

caption: Wild fowl
colour: red triangle, black duck symbol on white
explanation: Ducks or other wild fowl may be in or crossing the road ahead, often near water; slow down and give them room as they may waddle out slowly.
mnemonic: Duck symbol = wild fowl about.
notes: Commons: 'Wild fowl likely to be in road ahead (TSRGDNO 551.2)'. Depicts a duck.

caption: Area infected by animal disease
colour: white rectangular plate with red triangle and worded animal-disease warning
explanation: You are entering an area subject to animal-disease controls such as foot-and-mouth; obey any disinfection or movement restrictions and do not stop where you might spread infection.
mnemonic: Disease area = follow the controls.
notes: Commons: 'Area infected by animal disease ahead (TSRGDNO 574)'. Rare, deployed during outbreaks.
